messages:
maria: Customer acme-inc reports /invoke-tool returning 400 schema validation. Payload has a nested 'orders' array of strings and an extra 'debug' property. Happening in production since 07:30 UTC, high error volume.

maria: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tool":"order_parser","args":{"orders":["id-123","id-456"],"debug":true}}'

maria: API response: 400 {"error":"schema_validation","message":"/args/orders/0: expected object but got string; additionalProperties [\"debug\"] not allowed"}

jordan: Can you paste the schema used for the tool signature? I want to confirm expected shape.

maria: From onboarding.yaml: "orders": {"type":"array", "items": {"type":"object", "required": ["order_id", "items"]}, "additionalProperties": false}

vikram: Customer SDK v0.9.x used to accept bare order ids (array of strings). v0.10.0 enforces object shape. Looks like they haven't upgraded.

maria: Customer says they can't upgrade this week (locked release cycle). They have ~6k failing calls/day, account team flags billing noise due to retries. Marking P1 for customer impact.

deploy-bot: Note: change request 9923 created for temporary compatibility shim. Canary scheduled at 23:50 UTC if approved.

vikram: Propose temporary server-side coercion: if orders array contains strings, coerce each string -> {"order_id": <string>, "items": []} and ignore unknown extra props like "debug". Low-risk; keeps events flowing. Also add metric redwood.coerce.orders.count.

jordan: +1 to coercion. Also update error message to show actionable guidance when schema mismatch occurs (example payload + upgrade link).

maria: Customer approved the temporary coercion. I'll open an incident with account details and attach req id.

maria: Repro info: req_id=req_0ab12cd34ef, region=us-west-2, sdk_version=0.9.3, impacted since 2024-04-12T07:29:10Z

vikram: I'll take the PR for the coercion shim and the telemetry. Assigning to eng-runtime. Will include a toggle so we can revert if abused.

maria: Thanks — I'll notify Acme account team and set expectation: workaround deployed to canary then prod within a few hours.
